# zarketplace

> zarketplace (zarketplace.com, spelled with a z) is an Indian resale company for pre-owned and thrift clothing. It buys clothes from individuals at a fixed offer, checks every piece at its own hub, and sells them in its own name at a fixed price, with free delivery and Buyer Protection. Every item is sold and shipped by zarketplace. It is a shop, not a peer-to-peer marketplace.

zarketplace is a trading name of ADNIZ Private Limited (CIN U47711DL2023PTC418107), India.

## Buying from zarketplace

- Every item is pre-owned and one of a kind. Prices are fixed and shown on every listing. There is no haggling and no "DM for price".
- Every item comes to the zarketplace hub, is checked against its listing and photos, and is repacked before it ships to the buyer, tracked. If it does not match its listing, it does not ship.
- Delivery is free.
- Instant Ship items are already at the hub and are dispatched within 48 hours.
- Buyer Protection covers every order at no extra cost. If an item arrives not as described, or it is the wrong item, the buyer tells zarketplace within 7 days of delivery and gets a full refund, with the return postage paid by zarketplace.
- Change of mind and wrong fit are not refundable, because every item is a single piece. Every listing shows its measurements so the fit can be checked first.
- An order can be cancelled by email before it ships.
- Payment is by card, UPI, netbanking or wallet, through Razorpay.
- Every item is graded on one four-tier condition scale: Pristine, Great, Good and Worn.

## Selling to zarketplace

- Anyone can ask zarketplace for an offer at https://www.zarketplace.com/sell by adding photos, the size and an honest condition.
- Within 24 hours zarketplace makes an offer: a fixed amount in rupees that it will pay. The offer is open for 7 days, and once accepted it does not change.
- Selling is free and zarketplace pays for shipping. No GSTIN is needed.
- The item stays with its owner until someone buys it. Once accepted, it is on sale for up to 30 days and can be withdrawn at no cost until it is bought.
- When it is bought, zarketplace emails a prepaid label and a courier collects it from the door. It must be handed over within 5 days.
- zarketplace pays the agreed amount once the item reaches its hub and has been checked.
- zarketplace only buys authentic items. Counterfeits are refused and not paid for.

## Why

The most sustainable piece of clothing is one that already exists. India throws away around 7.8 million tonnes of textiles a year (Fashion for Good, Wealth in Waste, 2022). zarketplace only sells clothing that is already made, keeping it in use.
